disposition_reason: Nine metals were measured by AAS in 28 market samples of potato, onion, carrot, bean, lettuce and cabbage from Varaždin; Table 1 gives dry-weight means, SDs and ranges and the Discussion prints fresh-weight means.

study.design: Market survey: 28 samples of seven common vegetables bought at 11 sales locations
study.origin: not stated; authors suggest local sellers may have grown them in northwestern Croatia
study.method: Washed, air-dried, ground; HNO3/HClO4 digestion; GFAAS for As, Cd, Cr, Ni, Pb; flame AAS for Cu, Mn, Zn; hydride generation (FIAS) for Hg; PerkinElmer AAnalyst 800
study.lod_text: Solution LODs: As 0.05, Cd 0.002, Cr 0.004, Ni 0.07, Pb 0.05, Cu/Mn/Zn 0.0015, Hg 0.009 µg/L
study.qa: Single measurement per sample; calibration with atomic spectroscopy standards; no CRM or recovery reported
